neighbours.label: a definite noun together with the bare participle or short relative clause that follows it ('the treatment provided', 'the language used', 'the message sent', 'the work that we do')
fire: The outcome depends on the method used.
The jury was not convinced by the evidence presented at the trial.
Customers complained about the quality of the service provided.
The guide could not explain the route taken by the first climbers.
Nobody was satisfied with the answer given by the minister.
The receipt shows the price paid and the date of purchase.
The clerk wrote down the words spoken by each witness.
Results vary with the type of fuel that the engines burn.
quiet: The outcome depends on how we use it.
The lawyers presented their evidence at the trial on Monday.
Customers complained loudly and the shop provided refunds.
The first climbers took a route along the northern ridge.
The minister gave a short answer and left the room.
She paid the bill and asked for a receipt.
Each witness spoke slowly while the clerk wrote.
The engines burn diesel and start easily in winter.

notes: Card: peaks on the noun or the participle in 'the example chosen', 'the treatment provided', 'the message sent', 'the language used'; the output direction promotes ' presented', ' employed', ' provided', ' given'. Probes: 0.26-0.40 on such phrases, 0.01 on the same verbs used actively. Fires only at 0.3-0.4 of max in short sentences, so the median may be close to the 0.20 bar.
